Manual release: version bump to 0.2.1 and a .gitignore cleanup. First publish over npm trusted publishing (OIDC, no tokens).

### Bug fixes

* **tui:** give the syntax style its native resource owner ([695aaf1](https://github.com/syn7xx/opencode-dynamic-workflows/commit/695aaf159456d31ecd9fefe501978ec81ca95288))

OpenCode 2.1.0 ships `@opentui/core` 0.6.x, where `SyntaxStyle` requires an explicit native resource owner. The panel crashed on load with "SyntaxStyle requires an explicit resource owner". The plugin now targets OpenCode 2.1.0+ and passes `renderer.nativeScene`.
